#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Print environment variables and internal definitions relevant to this OpenClaw workspace.
#
# Usage:
#   ./print_env_and_internal.sh

echo "== Environment variables (env | sort) =="
env | sort

echo
echo "== Internal definitions (.openclaw/workspace-state.json, if present) =="
if [[ -f ".openclaw/workspace-state.json" ]]; then
  cat ".openclaw/workspace-state.json"
else
  echo "(missing) .openclaw/workspace-state.json"
fi
